news.title: Fed's Kashkari Says Inflation Still Too High
news.summary: Minnesota Fed President Neel Kashkari says inflation is still too high across all sectors of the economy, not just oil prices.  Kashkari told Fox News' Sunday Morning Futures that the Fed's job was to get inflation back to the 2% target rate.  Kashkari said that core inflation, which excludes fuel and food, "is running at about 3.4% right now."
